title: Astrid and the Witness Again
author: Odile Ravensworth
blurb: Marguerite Zhou, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the statute expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
